QuestInfo.name: The Lost Guard
QuestInfo.0: There is rumor of a #b#p2040023##k somewhere around #bEos Tower 92nd Floor#k...
QuestInfo.1: You met #p2040023# in Eos Tower 92nd Floor. He needs to go to the 59th floor to stand guard, but there are too many monsters in his way. Despite being A GUARD, he asked you to defeat #o3230307##k in #b#m221022300# and #m221022400##k#r#. He also wants #b20 Worn-Out Goggles#k... Ehhh, it might be good practice for you.
QuestInfo.2: You brought all the monster parts back to #p2040023#. Maybe he'll be brave enough to make it back now.

0.0: Hmmm... Where am I? I'm in charge of security for the 59th floor of Eos Tower, but I have nooo idea where I am. Dang. This place is also full of monsters, which makes it impossible for me to do my duty here. Can you help me out?

yes.0: Alright! It's a simple request, really. Please take out some of the monsters between me and my destination, the 59th floor of Eos Tower. Collect some of the stuff they drop as proof. That'll make it much easier for me to get to the 59th floor.
yes.1: It's the #r#o3230307##k monsters that are really ruining my day. Eliminate them and bring me #b20 #t4000123#k. I'll be waiting for you right here. No monsters will get past me, no sir!

1.0: Wow... you really took them all down. I knew I had an eye for talent.

yes.0: I must make my way down to the 59th Floor quickly. Thank you!

item.0: Defeat #o3230307##k at #b#m221022300# and #m221022400##k#r#. Then, collect #b20 Worn-Out Goggles#k.
